07.title: GUI check, PBR should be added automatically for one arm mode interface.

08.initial:
Configure an ubuntu vm as the Gateway as below, there're three network adptors on Ubuntu, suppose they are eth0, eth1, and eth2,   traffic comes from eth0, eth1 connects to Firewall one arm interface.
1.Enable ip forward:
vi /etc/sysctl.conf  uncomment net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
run command to make the change take effect right away: sysctl -p

2.add a custom route table:
echo "200 my" >> /etc/iproute2/rt_tables

add rules to the route table:
ip rule add iif eth0 pri 10000 table my
ip rule add iif eth2 pri 10001 table my
ip route add default via FW_IP table my
4.From a host in eth2 subnet, add route to eth0 via gateway eth1
08.title: Static one arm mode should work fine on lan interface.
08.result: Traffic should pass over the one-arm interface.

16.steps:
1.Enter configure mode on console, and configure x0 as one arm mode per below commands:
(edit-interface[X0])# one-arm-mode
(edit-interface[X0])# one-arm-p
(edit-interface[X0])# one-arm-peer 192.168.168.1
(edit-interface[X0])# commit
% Applying changes...
% Status returned processing command:
    commit
% Changes made.
2.Check the interface, acl and routing table on GUI, corresponding entries should be added for one arm mode interface.
3.Unassign one arm mode for interface x0:
(edit-interface[X0])# no one-arm-mode
(edit-interface[X0])# commit
% Applying changes...
% Status returned processing command:
    commit
% Changes made.
4.Check the interface, acl and routing table again on GUI, the interface should be back to static mode, and corresponding acl, route should be deleted.
